key: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed; and she had not known man.
s: Jephthah’s only daughter, who came out to meet him after his vow of a burnt-offering, comes home from the mountains; Rashi, on 11:39, takes her as perished because neither Jephthah nor Phinehas, who could release the vow, would stoop to go to the other, and Radak, on 11:39, as set apart in a house, away from people.

evidence.words: ותהי חק. גזרו שלא יעשה אדם עוד כן, שאלו הלך אצל פנחס, או הוא בא אצלו, היה מתיר לו נדרו, עמדו בגדולתן, ומבין שניהם אבדה … ויעש לה את נדרו אשר נדר. שעשה לה בית והכניסה שם והיתה שם פרושה מבני אדם ומדרכי העולם
evidence.gloss: [Rashi on 11:39, ‘and it was a custom’:] They decreed that no one should do so again, for had he gone to Phinehas, or had Phinehas come to him, he would have released his vow; they stood on their greatness, and between the two of them she perished … [Radak on 11:39, ‘and he did with her his vow which he had vowed’:] that he made her a house and brought her into it, and there she was set apart from people and from the ways of the world.

reason: Second judgement. verse.js ok, Judges 11:39 at [221,39]. Re-read packet.js tanakh 81 --verse 11.39 and 11.40: the Rashi words (on ותהי חק) and the Radak words (on ויעש לה את נדרו) are verbatim and contiguous in the packet. The refuter is right on tone (rules 5 and 6): the whole disagreement is whether the vow cost her life (Rashi: ומבין שניהם אבדה, decreed never to be repeated, both men punished; Metsudah English ‘her ruin’) or her seclusion (Radak: a house, פרושה מבני אדם). ‘Lost’ blurs that toward Radak; ‘perished’ renders the same Hebrew word and keeps the two readings distinct without resolving them. Corrected: ‘lost’ to ‘perished’ in the sentence and ‘she was lost’ to ‘she perished’ in the gloss; also dropped ‘first’ (the text says only that she came out to meet him, 11:34, under the vow of 11:31), giving ‘who came out to meet him’. Key, ref, at, src and evidence otherwise unchanged. entry-check ok on scratch/RV2-d081-p.json.
